recent_posts.title: Codeium · Free AI Code Completion & Chat
recent_posts.summary: Codeium introduces Termium, an AI-powered autocomplete tool for the terminal that helps developers with repetitive tasks such as git commands and inspecting Kubernetes pods. Termium acts as a layer between the user and the existing terminal, providing autocomplete suggestions based on command history and outputs. To install Termium, run a specific command in the terminal. While still in alpha, Termium aims to provide integrated workflows and compounding value in the developer experience.

recent_posts.title: The Golden Metrics: Characters per Opportunity and Percentage Code Written
recent_posts.summary: The post introduces two metrics, Characters per Opportunity (CPO) and Percentage Code Written (PCW), to measure the capabilities and value of AI code assistants. CPO is a benchmark metric that cannot be gamed and correlates with real tool value. PCW measures the value driven by a code assistant to the end developer. Existing benchmark metrics cannot be trusted due to gaming and incentivizing the wrong product decisions.

recent_posts.title: The Effect of Generative AI on the Human-Tool Interface
recent_posts.summary: Generative AI is revolutionizing the human-tool interface by enabling tools with high recall and precision across a wide range of tasks. The human-tool interface consists of the brain, surface, and interaction between humans and tools. Tools help humans overcome inefficiencies in their work, such as limited memory and knowledge retrieval abilities. Examples of human-tool interfaces include the terminal, explore panel in VSCode, and Intellisense. Generative AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT leverage smarter and more generic models to provide value. The most powerful generative AI tools focus on being capable, knowledgeable, intuitive, and smart.

recent_posts.title: Codeium · Free AI Code Completion & Chat
recent_posts.summary: Codeium announces SOC 2 Type II compliance, verifying their security and privacy practices. SOC 2 is a third-party audit that ensures companies meet standards for security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity, and privacy. Codeium is a leader in security compliance for generative AI tools, unlike GitHub Copilot and Amazon CodeWhisperer, which have not undergone third-party audits. Codeium plans to pursue even stronger compliance audits in the future.

recent_posts.title: Codeium · Free AI Code Completion & Chat
recent_posts.summary: The article discusses the importance of software licenses and compliance in AI code generation tools. It explains the difference between permissive and non-permissive licenses and the legal ramifications of violating them. Codeium uses proactive and reactive approaches to maximize compliance. Filters and audit logs are available for managing suggestions, and the company plans to improve matching algorithms and offer enterprise-level configurability.
